name: web-linux-console
description: Minimal web-based Linux console with xterm.js + node-pty

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,browser -c blue,green "nodemon server.js" "browser-sync start --proxy http://localhost:${PORT:-3000} --files 'public/**/*' --port ${BS_PORT:-3001} --no-open --no-notify --ws"
